title: App holds pane-command permissions; review prompt stops moving cards to Done
notes:
Two small cases where an agent is told to do what the app already does.

1. Pane-command permissions in the app's own settings. Main's screen passes settings { hooks: BOARD_GUARD_HOOKS } (src/main/chat/chat-sessions.ts ~338) and workers get workerSettings (src/main/workers/dispatch.ts ~103-117). Add permissions.allow for Bash(node "$DASHBOARD_COMMAND" pane *), session *, and the board command, so a fresh machine needs no hand copy from the dotfiles settings.json (lines ~127-128). Check whether autoMode.allow is honoured from flag settings. If it isn't, permissions.allow is enough.

2. The review prompt moves the card to Done itself (src/main/ship/review.ts ~129 `board move <card> Done`), but the worker's system prompt (dispatch.ts ~41-44) says the app moves branch cards and the worker must not. The app does move it on merge (src/main/board/pull-request-column.test.ts:83). Drop the move from the review prompt. First check that the follow writes the card on origin/main the way the board command does: review.ts ~108-113 explains why the move was put there. If it doesn't, say so on the card and stop.

Also correct docs/workflow/claude-md-audit.md:34. It says main's dispatch prompt asks for /simplify, but mainPrompt doesn't.

Do not bump the version.
